_comment: SURGX media registry AND THE LICENCE GATE. Absence of a licence record is a REFUSAL, not a default-allow (assets/kardiox-learn/ holds 872 images with no manifest and no licence record; that is the failure mode this exists to prevent). An uncleared entry is a WORK ORDER: it must say what is needed and where to look, and it renders as a caption plus 'visual pending' until it is cleared. Only self-authored inline SVG is cleared today, because it is the one kind of media that needs no sourcing and whose provenance we can honestly assert.

med.surgx.appendix-anatomy.title: Finding the appendix
med.surgx.appendix-anatomy.caption: The three taeniae coli converge on the base of the appendix. Following one distally locates the base whatever the position of the tip.

med.surgx.calot-triangle.title: The hepatocystic triangle
med.surgx.calot-triangle.caption: Bounded by the cystic duct, the common hepatic duct and the inferior border of the liver. Lateral traction on the infundibulum opens it; cephalad traction closes it and aligns the cystic duct with the common bile duct.

med.surgx.cvs-diagram.title: The Critical View of Safety
med.surgx.cvs-diagram.caption: Three criteria, all required: the hepatocystic triangle cleared of fat and fibrous tissue, the lower third of the gallbladder separated from the cystic plate, and exactly two structures entering the gallbladder.

med.surgx.inguinal-canal.title: Direct, indirect and femoral
med.surgx.inguinal-canal.caption: The inferior epigastric vessels separate an indirect hernia (lateral, through the deep ring) from a direct one (medial, through Hesselbach triangle). A femoral hernia passes below the inguinal ligament, medial to the vein.

med.surgx.lap-quadrants.title: The exploration sequence
med.surgx.lap-quadrants.caption: The same order every time: supracolic, small bowel from the duodenojejunal flexure to the caecum, colon, both paracolic gutters, pelvis, retroperitoneum. The numbering is the point.

med.surgx.appendix-base.caption: Endoscopic view of the appendix base cleared circumferentially, with healthy caecal wall visible on both sides before an endoloop is applied.
med.surgx.appendix-base.note: WORK ORDER: an intra-operative still showing a properly cleared base. Source it either from an openly licensed surgical atlas (CC BY or CC0 only) or produce it in-house with documented patient consent for educational use. Do NOT take a frame from a commercial atlas or a YouTube video.

med.surgx.abscess-deloculation.caption: A multiloculated abscess cavity in cross-section, showing why a single stab incision drains only one compartment.
med.surgx.abscess-deloculation.note: WORK ORDER: authorable in-house as an inline SVG in surgx-diagrams.js, in the same style as the other five. Until it is drawn it stays refused. Estimated effort: one diagram.

med.surgx.cvs-video.caption: A narrated laparoscopic cholecystectomy demonstrating achievement of the Critical View of Safety.
med.surgx.cvs-video.note: WORK ORDER: SAGES publishes safe-cholecystectomy teaching video. Confirm the embedding terms in writing before adding videoId + embeddable:true. Do not hotlink or re-host. Note that a permitted embed also needs the /_site/yt shim on native, as CliniX documents.
